newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-BULLS ACTIVATE HARPER, PUT RODMAN ON SUSPENDED LIST.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-BULLS ACTIVATE HARPER, PUT RODMAN ON SUSPENDED LIST.

text.p: The Chicago Bulls have activated guard Ron Harper from the injured list in time for Thursday night's game against the Cavaliers in Cleveland, and placed forward Dennis Rodman on the suspended list.

Harper was placed on the injured list January 14 with a cervical spine strain and also has had problems with his knee and foot. Harper has been practicing with the team this week and travelled with the Bulls to Cleveland.

The league informed the Bulls this week that they can activate Harper without taking someone off the roster. Originally, they were told that Rodman, who is suspended through the All-Star break for kicking a cameraman, could not be replaced without disabling another player.
Harper had started 34 games, averaging 6.5 points and 2.8 rebounds per outing. He teams with Michael Jordan to give the Bulls one of the best defensive backcourts in the league.
